enumDescriptions.MONTHLY_WEEK: Pay periods based on specific week of each month (e.g., 2nd Friday)
enumDescriptions.SEMI_MONTHLY: 24 pay periods per year (twice per month on specific dates)
enumDescriptions.EVERY_N_WEEKS: Custom intervals of N weeks (e.g., bi-weekly = 2 weeks)

monthly_day.title: Monthly Start Day
monthly_day.description: For MONTHLY type: Day of month when pay period starts. Use -1 for last day of month, 0-27 for specific day.

month_week_num.title: Month Week Number
month_week_num.description: For MONTHLY_WEEK type: Which week of the month (1-4 for first through fourth week, -1 for last week).

month_week_day.title: Month Week Day
month_week_day.description: For MONTHLY_WEEK type: Day of the week (1=Sunday, 2=Monday, 3=Tuesday, 4=Wednesday, 5=Thursday, 6=Friday, 7=Saturday).

semi_monthly_start1.title: Semi-Monthly Start Day 1
semi_monthly_start1.description: For SEMI_MONTHLY type: First start day of the month (1-27). This creates the first pay period of each month.

semi_monthly_start2.title: Semi-Monthly Start Day 2
semi_monthly_start2.description: For SEMI_MONTHLY type: Second start day of the month (2-31). Must be greater than semi_monthly_start1. Creates the second pay period of each month.

weekly_start_day.title: Weekly Start Day
weekly_start_day.description: For WEEKLY type: Day of the week when pay period starts (1=Sunday through 7=Saturday).

n_weeks_num.title: Number of Weeks
n_weeks_num.description: For EVERY_N_WEEKS type: Number of weeks in each pay period (e.g., 2 for bi-weekly, 3 for tri-weekly).

n_weeks_start_date.title: N Weeks Start Date
n_weeks_start_date.description: For EVERY_N_WEEKS type: Reference start date for calculating pay periods (YYYY-MM-DD). All subsequent periods calculated from this anchor date.

n_days_num.title: Number of Days
n_days_num.description: For EVERY_N_DAYS type: Number of days in each pay period (e.g., 10 for every 10 days, 15 for every 15 days).

n_days_start_date.title: N Days Start Date
n_days_start_date.description: For EVERY_N_DAYS type: Reference start date for calculating pay periods (YYYY-MM-DD). All subsequent periods calculated from this anchor date.

num_periods_in_year.title: Number of Periods in Year
num_periods_in_year.description: Expected number of pay periods in a year based on frequency (e.g., 52 for weekly, 26 for bi-weekly, 24 for semi-monthly, 12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly). Used for validation and reporting.

num_periods_override.title: Override Number of Periods
num_periods_override.description: Whether to override the calculated number of periods per year with a custom value. Useful for non-standard pay schedules.

auto_lock_enabled.title: Auto Lock Enabled
auto_lock_enabled.description: Whether to automatically lock pay periods after a specified number of days. Helps prevent accidental changes to processed payrolls and ensures data integrity.

auto_lock_days.title: Auto Lock Days
auto_lock_days.description: Number of days after period end date when auto-lock occurs. Prevents modifications to payroll data after processing deadline. Required when auto_lock_enabled is true.

auto_remove_employees_not_in_payroll.title: Auto Remove Employees Not in Payroll
auto_remove_employees_not_in_payroll.description: Whether to automatically remove employees from pay periods when they are not included in payroll processing.

enforce_pay_period_profile.title: Enforce Pay Period Profile
enforce_pay_period_profile.description: Whether to strictly enforce this pay period profile's rules and prevent manual overrides.

auto_create_payrolls.title: Auto Create Payrolls
auto_create_payrolls.description: Whether to automatically create payroll records when new pay periods are generated.

auto_initiate_payrolls.title: Auto Initiate Payrolls
auto_initiate_payrolls.description: Whether to automatically initiate payrolls for this profile.

auto_initiate_pst_type.title: Auto Initiate PST Type
auto_initiate_pst_type.description: The PST type to use when auto initiating payrolls for this profile.

default_invoice_generator_id.title: Default Invoice Generator ID
default_invoice_generator_id.description: ID of the default invoice generator to use for payroll processing with this profile.

pay_date_calc_type.title: Pay Date Calculation Type
pay_date_calc_type.description: Method for calculating pay dates relative to pay period dates.

enumDescriptions.DATE_BASED_PP_END: Pay date calculated as days offset from period end date
enumDescriptions.WEEK_DAY_BASED: Pay date calculated as specific weekday relative to period end
enumDescriptions.DATE_BASED_PP_START: Pay date calculated as days offset from period start date
enumDescriptions.SEMI_MONTHLY: Pay date calculated using specific days of the month

pay_date_days_from_end.title: Pay Date Days From End
pay_date_days_from_end.description: For DATE_BASED_PP_END type: Number of days after period end date for pay date. Positive values are after period end, negative values are before period end (e.g., -2 means 2 days before period end).

pay_date_days_from_start.title: Pay Date Days From Start
pay_date_days_from_start.description: For DATE_BASED_PP_START type: Number of days after period start date for pay date. Positive values are after period start, negative values are before period start (e.g., 7 means 7 days after period start).

pay_date_week_day.title: Pay Date Week Day
pay_date_week_day.description: For WEEK_DAY_BASED type: Day of the week for pay date (1=Sunday through 7=Saturday). Used with pay_date_week_day_type to determine exact pay date.

pay_date_week_day_type.title: Pay Date Week Day Type
pay_date_week_day_type.description: For WEEK_DAY_BASED type: Relationship of pay date weekday to period end.

enumDescriptions.PRIOR: Weekday occurring before period end date
enumDescriptions.CLOSEST: Weekday nearest to period end date (before or after)
enumDescriptions.FOLLOWING: Weekday occurring after period end date

pay_date_adjust_by_days.title: Pay Date Adjust By Days
pay_date_adjust_by_days.description: For WEEK_DAY_BASED type: Additional days to adjust the calculated pay date. Can be positive (later) or negative (earlier). Applied after weekday calculation.

pay_date_semi_monthly_day1.title: Semi-Monthly Pay Date Day 1
pay_date_semi_monthly_day1.description: For SEMI_MONTHLY pay_date_calc_type: Day of month for first semi-monthly pay date (1-31). Typically corresponds to first pay period of the month.

pay_date_semi_monthly_day2.title: Semi-Monthly Pay Date Day 2
pay_date_semi_monthly_day2.description: For SEMI_MONTHLY pay_date_calc_type: Day of month for second semi-monthly pay date (1-31). Typically corresponds to second pay period of the month.

pay_date_semi_monthly_direction.title: Semi-Monthly Pay Date Direction
pay_date_semi_monthly_direction.description: For SEMI_MONTHLY pay_date_calc_type: Direction of pay date relative to period end when specified day doesn't exist in month.

enumDescriptions.NONE: Use exact day specified, may cause errors if day doesn't exist
enumDescriptions.FORWARD: Move forward to next available day if specified day doesn't exist
enumDescriptions.BACK: Move backward to previous available day if specified day doesn't exist

saturday_move_enabled.title: Saturday Move Enabled
saturday_move_enabled.description: Whether to move pay dates that fall on Saturday to a different day. Important for ensuring employees receive pay on business days when banks are open.

saturday_move_type.title: Saturday Move Type
saturday_move_type.description: How to move pay dates when they fall on Saturday. Only used when saturday_move_enabled is true.

enumDescriptions.PREV_BUSINESS_DAY: Move to previous business day (skip weekends)
enumDescriptions.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY: Move to next business day (skip weekends)
enumDescriptions.CLOSEST_BUSINESS_DAY: Move to closest business day (before or after)
enumDescriptions.MONTH_END: Move to last business day of month
enumDescriptions.MONTH_START: Move to first business day of month

sunday_move_enabled.title: Sunday Move Enabled
sunday_move_enabled.description: Whether to move pay dates that fall on Sunday to a different day. Important for ensuring employees receive pay on business days when banks are open.

sunday_move_type.title: Sunday Move Type
sunday_move_type.description: How to move pay dates when they fall on Sunday. Only used when sunday_move_enabled is true.

holiday_move_enabled.title: Holiday Move Enabled
holiday_move_enabled.description: Whether to move pay dates that fall on company holidays to a different day. Ensures employees receive pay when banks and businesses are operational.

holiday_move_type.title: Holiday Move Type
holiday_move_type.description: How to move pay dates when they fall on holidays. Only used when holiday_move_enabled is true.

holiday_profile_id.title: Holiday Profile ID
holiday_profile_id.description: ID of the company holiday profile to use for determining which days are holidays. Required when holiday_move_enabled is true. References the company's defined holiday calendar.

within_month_end_enabled.title: Within Month End Enabled
within_month_end_enabled.description: Whether to enable special handling for pay dates near month end boundaries. Useful for accounting periods and month-end processing requirements.

within_month_end_move_type.title: Within Month End Move Type
within_month_end_move_type.description: How to adjust pay dates for month end boundaries. Only used when within_month_end_enabled is true.

within_month_end_num_days.title: Within Month End Number of Days
within_month_end_num_days.description: Number of days from month end to trigger special handling. For example, if set to 3, pay dates within 3 days of month end will be adjusted. Only used when within_month_end_enabled is true.

submit_date_days.title: Submit Date Days
submit_date_days.description: Number of days before pay date when payroll must be submitted for processing. Ensures adequate time for payroll review and approval before payment.

submit_before_time.title: Submit Before Time
submit_before_time.description: Time of day (in seconds since midnight) when payroll submission deadline occurs. For example, 64800 = 6:00 PM (18:00). Used with submit_date_days to set precise submission deadlines.

process_date_days.title: Process Date Days
process_date_days.description: Number of days before pay date when payroll processing must be completed. Ensures adequate time for final payroll processing and bank file generation.

process_before_time.title: Process Before Time
process_before_time.description: Time of day (in seconds since midnight) when payroll processing deadline occurs. For example, 43200 = 12:00 PM (noon). Used with process_date_days to set precise processing deadlines.

change_pay_periods_from_date.title: Change Pay Periods From Date
change_pay_periods_from_date.description: Date from which pay period changes should take effect (YYYY-MM-DD). Used when modifying existing pay period configurations.
